book.name: Ŋwa' Lemme
book.title: Ŋwa' Lemme di boom bo ntum e bo Jisos e

content: Ɛ Baul taŋe diuw fwe dvu Nfon Aglifa
Ɛ Nfon Aglifa mum gay ɛ̂ Baul lɛ, “Ɛ̀ nu bvudvuu bvuw keseen keejeme bô diuw wo.” Ɛ Baul mum cake kebo we, kɛw keetaŋe diuw we, gay lɛ,
“Nyaa', me n'yɛne lɛ keshi kem nu ɛ joŋ lɛ baay keenleem etaŋe diuw wɛm fwe dvu bó ɛbɛn yî mwɛɛm mvunciim mvù Bojuu teytey yî yɛm e.
Me njemyi lɛ nɛn, njefo bó looci lɛ kee nce woŋ Bojuu noo bombew bò bó ké no kɛŋke. Nonɛn, me ɛ no nlɛke lɛ bó eyekɛ kɛ lɛ nyɛkeey eyuw fiɛɛ fì me nu enjeme.
Bojuu bocii kee nce wɛm ɛ kɛw naa ɛ me mbɛɛ lo. Bó kee no me nto ncee woŋ wese le noo Jɛlusalɛm.

Ɛ bó kee naa ntay lɛ ɛ kɛw lo ncejole nu ɛ me nu wee ŋgoo Bofalasii ɛ ɛ̀ nu ŋgoo yì looci tɛmyi yî fiɛɛ fi Nyo' le fele yimi yicii. Fin nu fiɛɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu lɛ bó kooŋke keejeme, ɛ́ bó ebee lɛ ɛ̀ nu kecɛɛy.
Me ɛ no nleeme lɛ fɛn keseen yî nsaw e njefo me ntaale fwe, ŋkee ŋkawma wvù Nyo' to kawɛɛ bo'icee bosɛse dvú.
Ŋkawma wvun nu lɛ wvù dikfuu disɛse di yuufe ncow difɛɛ cɛyte no bó bunlee Nyo' shiee le ɛntaŋ bô ɛmvunsheeŋ. Nyaa', ɛ̀ nu lɛ nje ŋkawma wvudvu wvun wvù Bojuu kɛŋke lɛ nsaw dvú bee bó.
Me ɛ no mbiite ɛ̂ bó noo ɛ̂ bonyii bocii lɛ laa ɛ̀ ge la wvù ben yɛne ɛ fí tɛmyi keebee lɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ Nyo' ebvuse wee yî kpwe le lɛ?
Me kebɛɛ nto ŋkpwawci naa lɛ me ŋkɛŋke keeŋge fiɛɛ ficii keenfiwsɛ diee di Jisos wvu Nasalɛt e.

Ɛ fifin nu naa fiɛɛ fì me nto ŋgeɛ Jɛlusalɛm. Me nto nu ɛ nfi mvuŋgay ɛ̂ bocee ncese bo baay baay ŋkooyɛ bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le nteen, nfen yew ncaw e. Kɛ ɛ̀ to mɛy kɛ fin kɛ. Bó to ké dioo nu lɛ bó nu eyuwyɛ bó, ɛ me tɛn ntom.

Me nto nyaa ŋgɛw ɛ̂ bó ɛfonɛfon yéw bunle le yicii, ŋkane lɛ bó ejemyi díɛw yì befe ɛkumɛ wee wvù Jisos. Ɛ shém ffuuke me bô bó baay, ɛ me mbone bikaa ɛ̂ bó ɛjim, ŋgɛne mbuyte bilaante bi bitum bimew e.
Ɛ Baul bvuu jeme no wvú to kumɛnɛɛ no nu wee Klistu
Ɛ me ŋke mum nɛ no ŋgɛne Damaskus, ɛ bocee ncese bo baay baay ɛ saŋ ŋwa', ɛ nya me mvuŋgay.
Nyaa', ɛ me ndioo ŋgɛne ɛ ɛ̀ nu lɛ ɛmvunsheeŋ ɛntelɛŋ, ɛ me nɛ n'yɛn ɛ n'yuu mvu nɛ law fowe baa fele diuu, shii to yî bee bonyii bò bee bó to lɛne le.

Ɛ bese bocii nɛ gbwekɛn fokuse, ɛ me n'yuw ɛ diɛw bife ɛ̂ me ɛ̂ díɛw Ibulu le lɛ, ‘Saul, Saul, wo bone bikaa ɛ̂ me ɛjim nɛn nje la? Wo gee nɛn, kfune ɛ ɛ̀ nu ye yo, diɛwɛ na' lemme fô wvú bone ye yî kembaŋ ke ice le.’
Ɛ me mbife lɛ, ‘Ɛ̀ nu wo wvù yɛɛ Tata?’ Ɛ wvú tfuse lɛ, ‘Ɛ̀ nu me wvù Jisos, ɛ ɛ̀ nu me wvù wo bone bikaa ɛjim jodvu.
Ja leem we. Fiɛɛ fì ge me ɛ mbuynɛn fô wo le nu lɛ me embaa wo wee wɛm lemme le, ɛ́ wo efewcì mwɛɛm mvù wo yɛn ɛbɛn bô mvù me mbɛɛ ŋke enduŋcɛ ɛ̂ wo le.
Me nu ŋke enfi wo can Bojuu noo bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu le, ɛ ɛ̀ nu bó bò me nu entum wo fô bó le.

Wo nu ke egɛn eyene ɛjisɛ ɛbo, ebvuse bó ɛ̂ ɛjiwɛ le, eleke bó ɛ̂ n'yuu le, ɛ́ bó ebuy can Satan e, enu bô bo Nyo', ɛ́ bó elese fitele yî yɛm e, ɛ́ Nyo' elɛɛshɛ bibefɛ bibole. Ɛ́ bó ke emum ekɛŋkɛ keleŋ fô bvudvuu bvù bonyii bò wvú nu ɛ ge lɛ ɛ̀ nu naa bew e.’
Nyaa', no fí to kooyɛɛ lɛ nonɛn, ɛ me mum ŋge kɛ lɛ no wvú jemyɛɛ ɛ̂ me fowe.

Ɛ me mum n'yaw ŋkɛw no nfewci Damaskus, nsɛ ŋke ŋgɛn Jɛlusalɛm. Ɛ me no ŋghane woŋ wvù Judea le tfuu noo bitum e bicii bì yaa nu kɛ bi Bojuu le, nfewci ɛ̂ bó lɛ bó ekumɛn mvuntelem mvubole, etu bô bo Nyo', egeè ɛ ɛ̀ nu mwɛɛm mvù duŋci lɛ bó nu ɛ kumɛn wase.
Ɛ̀ nɛɛ lɛ fiɛɛ fì to geɛ ɛ́ Bojuu sɛ koo me yew ncese le egomte keeyu.

Geenɛn, Nyo' ɛ se ɛ no fii me ɛ to ɛ buy ɛbɛn e. Me ɛ mum ɛ no nleeme fɛn nfewci tɛn ɛ̂ bonyii bo baay baay noo bo caan caan. Ɛ fiɛɛ fì me nfewci nu kɛ fí fì Muses bô bonyii bo ntum Nyo' le to teete lɛ fí nu ke ekooy.
Bó to gayte lɛ Mboyse wvù Nyo' to kawɛɛ kɛŋke keeke eyɛn ŋgɛw, enu wee wvu fwe keebuy yî kpwe le, eduŋcɛ n'yuu ɛ̂ Bojuu noo bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu.”
No Baul to taŋyi kɛ diuw we gɛne, ɛ Fɛstus nɛ kay lo wvú gay lɛ, “Baul wo jewte wase lo. N'yɛɛyi wo wvu baay nu ɛ ge wase wo ɛ nɛ ɛ no jewte lo.”
Ɛ Baul tfuse ɛ̂ Fɛstus lɛ, “Kɛ me n'yaa njewte kɛ wee wvu baay. Fiɛɛ fì me njemyi nu kecɛɛy, ɛ me njemyi bô bvufee bwem fó.
Me njemyi ɛ̂ Nfon ɛndan nɛn, njefo bó kee mwɛɛm mvun ɛ kɛ mvú to kooyi ɛ̂ kenyilɛ le kɛ, ɛ kɛ fimew yaa nu dvú fì bó nu sɛ bó kee lo kɛ.
Nyaa', bó nu ɛ bee kɛ fiɛɛ fì Boŋwa' bo bonyii bo ntum Nyo' le jemyi lɛ? Me ŋkee lɛ bó nu lɛ ɛ bee.”
Ɛ Nfon Aglifa bife ɛ̂ Baul lɛ, “Wo kpwaake lɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ wo ebaŋke me ɛ́ me entu wee Klistu kɛ yî kefew e caan nɛn e?”

Ɛ Baul tfuse lɛ, “Kɛnɛɛ kí nu caan, kɛnɛɛ kí nu baay, tu bunle yɛm fô Nyo' le nu kɛ lɛ fo emɛy kɛ wo kɛ. Wee tfuu wvù nu fɛn ɛbɛn yuuke no me njemyi ebaŋke tɛn enu diɛwɛ me le, geenɛn, efufe kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu boncaw ban.”
Ɛ Nfon nɛ ja we, ɛ wee sa' bô Bɛnis noo bonyii bò bô bó to shilɛɛ bi.
Ɛ bó buy, no jemyi ɛbonɛbon lɛ, “Wee wvun baa ge fiɛɛ fì bó eyu lo wvú kɛnɛɛ elese wvú yew ncaw e kɛ.”
Ɛ Nfon Aglifa gay ɛ̂ Fɛstus lɛ, “Ɛ́ ɛ̀ be baa nu lɛ wee wvun nu ɛ lɛkɛ wase lɛ nsaw we egɛn fô Nfon wvu Lum e, tu bó be ɛ cinɛ wvú le.”
